text: Users can create, rename, reorder, edit, and delete custom ingress playlists containing ordered Home Assistant media references.
Users can save existing Home Assistant provider playlist references in the BL-HAOS playlist library.
Saved playlist definitions persist across Home Assistant and add-on restarts; unavailable or stale media references are identified to the user.
Saved playlists store Home Assistant media references and required display/order metadata, not resolved playback URLs or provider credentials.
